title: Herbal Light Syrian Chicken Stir Fry
description: A light and herbal Syrian chicken stir fry featuring gochujang, perfect for a low-sodium meal prep option. This dish is made with fresh herbs and spices for a flavorful and healthy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the gochujang and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped parsley and mint to the skillet and cook until wilted.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the herbal mixture.
Season with salt-free seasoning blend to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with pita bread.
